definitions.explanation: A body or group established for a particular purpose.
A machine that produces power or movement.

notes:
{機関|きかん} has two main meanings: organization and engine.

ORGANIZATION MEANING:
- ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧{機関|きかん} (government agency)
- ⟦{金融|きんゆう}→金融：02664_kinyuu⟧{機関|きかん} (financial institution)
- ⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧{機関|きかん} (medical institution)
- ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧{機関|きかん} (educational institution)
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{機関|きかん} (international organization)

ENGINE MEANING:
- ⟦{蒸気|じょうき}→蒸気：04278_jouki⟧{機関|きかん} (steam engine)
- ⟦{機関|きかん}{車|しゃ}→機関車：25424_kikansha⟧ (locomotive)

HOMOPHONES:

- ⟦{器官|きかん}→器官：02685_kikan⟧: organ (body part)
